heading: Student companions
subheading: AI study buddies that teach your students this material topic by topic, give practice questions and answer doubts, strictly from the book with page citations.

empty.title: No companion yet
empty.body: Create a visual study buddy on this knowledge base. Choose the topics it covers and who gets it; it teaches only what the material says. Your institute’s AI credits pay for it.

toast.saveFailed: Couldn’t save the companion. Please try again.
toast.archiveFailed: Couldn’t archive the companion. Please try again.

archive.heading: Archive {{name}}?
archive.body: Students will stop seeing it on their dashboard and can’t open it any more. Their progress is kept.

errors.name: Give the companion a name.
errors.modes: Turn on at least one of Learn, Practice or Ask doubts.
errors.audience: Choose at least one batch or student.
errors.cap: Enter a whole number from 0 to 500.
errors.dates: The end date must be after the start date.

basics.title: Basics
basics.name: Name
basics.descriptionPlaceholder: Learn Class 10 Biology with me, one chapter at a time
basics.personaPlaceholder: Friendly and patient, uses cricket examples, celebrates small wins…
basics.personaHint: This shapes the tone only. Answers always stay within the book.

scope.title: What it covers
scope.hint: Pick chapters or subtopics, or leave everything unticked to cover the whole knowledge base.
scope.noTopics: This knowledge base has no topic map yet, so the companion will cover all of it.

learn.label: Learn
learn.hint: Visual lessons built from the book: figures, tables, worked examples and quick checks.

practice.label: Practice
practice.hint: Multiple-choice questions per topic with instant explanations.

ask.label: Ask doubts
ask.hint: Answers from the book with page citations. Off-topic questions are politely declined.

who.title: Who sees it
who.studentSearch: Search students by name, email or username

display.title: Display and limits
display.dashboardHint: Appears in the “Your study companions” row.
display.voiceHint: Students can listen to lessons and answers.
display.activeHint: Paused companions are hidden from students until you turn them back on.
display.windowHint: Optional. Leave both dates empty to keep it available all the time.

prepare.heading: Prepare lessons
prepare.why: Each lesson is prepared once and shared by every student. If you don’t prepare in advance, the first student to open a topic waits about 1-2 minutes while it’s prepared.
prepare.estimateFailed: Couldn’t work out the cost. Please try again.
prepare.nothingToDo: All lessons are ready or already being prepared.
prepare.questionNext: Prepare the next {{count}} of {{total}} lessons now?
prepare.noCredits: Not enough AI credits. Top up to prepare these lessons.
prepare.runAgain: Lessons are prepared in batches of up to 40. Run this again for the rest.
prepare.started_one: Preparing {{count}} lesson — it’ll be ready in a few minutes
prepare.started_other: Preparing {{count}} lessons — they’ll be ready in a few minutes
prepare.startFailed: Couldn’t start preparing the lessons. Please try again.

insights.heading: Learner progress · {{name}}
insights.emptyBody: Progress appears here as soon as a student opens a topic or asks a doubt.

lessons.heading: Lessons · {{name}}
lessons.summary: {{ready}} of {{total}} lessons ready. Preview any topic to see exactly what students will see.
lessons.learnOff: Learn is turned off for this companion, so lessons can’t be previewed.
lessons.noTopics: No topics in this companion’s scope.

preview.heading: Preview · {{title}}
preview.intro: This is exactly what students see, card by card. The correct answer of each quick check is highlighted for you.
preview.willPrepare: This lesson isn’t prepared yet. Previewing it will prepare it now, which uses AI credits (about 5) and takes a minute or two. Students will then get it instantly.
preview.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the lesson. Please try again.
preview.missing: This lesson hasn’t been prepared yet.
preview.generatingProgress: Preparing the lesson… {{ready}} of {{total}} cards ready
preview.cardPending: This card is still being prepared…
